# The pagoda's spire (sorin), dropped on the top storey when a run ends: a gold mast with four rings
# and a ball. Up Z, origin at its foot.
new
add mesh cylinder --name Base --vertices 6 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.18 --location 0 0 0.09
add mesh cylinder --name Mast --vertices 6 --radius 0.07 --depth 1.3 --location 0 0 0.8
add mesh cylinder --name R0 --vertices 8 --radius 0.22 --depth 0.07 --location 0 0 0.45
add mesh cylinder --name R1 --vertices 8 --radius 0.19 --depth 0.07 --location 0 0 0.65
add mesh cylinder --name R2 --vertices 8 --radius 0.16 --depth 0.07 --location 0 0 0.85
add mesh cylinder --name R3 --vertices 8 --radius 0.13 --depth 0.07 --location 0 0 1.05
add mesh ico-sphere --name Ball --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.13 --location 0 0 1.5
material new Gold --base-color 0.894 0.580 0.227
select all
material assign Gold
shade flat
export spire.glb
